_meta.name: English
_meta.note: Every other catalog is validated against this file by `php bin/revoap-i18n.php lint`. Keys must not be renamed here without updating all four siblings.

app.name: RevoAp
app.description: RevoAp routes your query through a 4-layer LLM consensus pipeline and shows the full audit trail.

common.copy_failed: Could not copy — your browser blocked clipboard access
common.no_results_hint: Try a different query or clear the filters.
common.name: Name
common.confirm_action: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
common.network_error: Network error — the server did not respond.
common.unauthorized: You are not authorized. Unlock the admin area first.
common.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
common.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {retry_after} s.

theme.mode_help: System follows your operating system and updates live.
theme.accent_help: Re-colours buttons, links, focus rings and charts. Every token derives from it.
theme.density_help: Compact fits roughly 30 % more rows on screen — useful for the admin tables.

locale.label: Language
locale.help: Changes the whole console, including dates, numbers and plural forms.
locale.rtl_notice: This language is written right-to-left; the layout mirrors automatically.

chat.title: Chat
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.clear_confirm: Clear the current query and result?
chat.share_failed: Could not create a shared link
chat.consensus_skill_help: The round-2 system prompt and the scoring backend both come from the active skill.
chat.reasoning_help: Forwarded to providers that support thinking modes.
chat.attach_hint: Text, code, Markdown, JSON and PDF up to {size}.
chat.query_too_short: Write a little more — at least {n} characters.
chat.query_too_long: The query is too long: {length} of {max} characters.
chat.no_history: No runs yet. Ask something to see the pipeline.
chat.empty_state_body: Your query is sent to several models in parallel. Their answers are normalised, compared for agreement and synthesised into one result — with every step visible.
chat.suggestion_1: Compare three database designs for an event log
chat.suggestion_2: Review this function for concurrency bugs
chat.suggestion_3: Summarise the trade-offs of event sourcing
chat.model_pool_help: Pick the LLMs L1 will query in parallel. Each row is one independent answer; L2/L3/L4 then normalize, score and synthesize.
chat.models_minimum: Select at least {n} models for a meaningful consensus.
chat.worker_offline: The background worker is not running — this request will be handled inline and may be slower.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.l0_help: Chooses the consensus skill and the model pool for this query.
pipeline.l1_help: Every selected model answers the same prompt in parallel.
pipeline.l2_help: Each answer is reduced to a comparable structure.
pipeline.l3_help: Structures are clustered and scored for cross-model agreement.
pipeline.l4_help: A synthesis model writes the final answer from the consensus.
pipeline.score_help: The fraction of semantic content covered by clusters shared across models.
pipeline.final_answer_help: Synthesized by L4 from the agreed content of every model.
pipeline.failed_hint: Every step still running was marked failed; the audit trail below shows why.
pipeline.cache_hit_help: An identical request was answered before; the provider was not called again.
pipeline.model_dropped_help: The circuit breaker opened after repeated failures, so this model did not answer.
pipeline.model_substituted_help: The requested model was unavailable, so the fallback chain supplied a replacement.
pipeline.reconnected: The stream dropped and was reconnected.
pipeline.sse_unsupported: Your browser does not support server-sent events; polling instead.

stats.title: Session statistics
stats.no_cost_data: The providers did not report a cost for this run.

models.title: Models
models.catalog_help: Every model the connected providers currently serve.
models.select_diverse_help: Chooses models from as many different vendors as possible — a council from one vendor agrees with itself.
models.search_placeholder: Filter by model, vendor or capability…
models.breaker_open_help: Recent calls failed repeatedly. The pipeline skips this model until the breaker closes.
models.linked_models_help: The analyzer, the L4 synthesis model and the L3 conflict arbiter are bound to a provider outside the consensus pool. They are kept in step with the catalogue here.
models.preset_help: A preset is a named model pool the domain router can pick for a query.
models.no_models_at_all: The catalogue is empty. Add a provider key in Settings and refresh.
models.batch_help: Models that support the provider's batch endpoint can be used for cheap offline runs.

fallback.title: Fallback & alternatives
fallback.subtitle: What happens when a selected model cannot answer.
fallback.help: When a model in the consensus pool is unavailable — key rejected, quota exhausted, 404 from the provider, or an open circuit breaker — RevoAp can either run a smaller council or substitute a replacement. Substitution keeps the council at the size you asked for, which is what the consensus score means.
fallback.mode_none_help: The run proceeds with fewer members and the gap is reported.
fallback.mode_auto_help: Substitute silently from the chain, then report every replacement with the run.
fallback.mode_ask_help: The run pauses and offers the alternatives; nothing is chosen for you.
fallback.mode_strict_help: A missing member aborts the run instead of weakening the result.
fallback.chain_help: Ordered candidates. The first available one wins.
fallback.chain_empty: No fallback chain — a broken model simply drops out.
fallback.reorder_hint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow buttons.
fallback.prefer_vendor_diversity_help: Skip a candidate whose vendor is already in the pool while another vendor is available.
fallback.same_vendor_only_help: Only substitute a model from the same provider family, so pricing and capabilities stay comparable.
fallback.respect_context_window_help: Never substitute a model with a smaller context window than the one it replaces.
fallback.max_cost_multiplier_help: A replacement may cost at most this many times the original model. 1.5 allows a 50 % more expensive model.
fallback.no_alternatives: No suitable alternative is available right now.
fallback.no_alternatives_hint: Every candidate is either unavailable, already in the pool, or excluded by the rules above.
fallback.reason_key_missing: No API key for this provider
fallback.reason_not_found: The provider does not serve this model any more
fallback.reason_breaker: Circuit breaker open after repeated failures
fallback.reason_context: Context window too small for this query
fallback.score_help: How well the candidate matches the original model: vendor independence, context window, latency history, success rate and price.
fallback.monitor_help: Probes the selected models on a schedule so a broken provider is known before a user hits it.
fallback.dry_run_help: Show what would be substituted without changing the pool.
fallback.dry_run_result: With the current rules, {from} would be replaced by {to}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.providers_help: API keys are stored in .{provider}.key files with mode 0600 and are never echoed back to the browser.
settings.api_key_masked: The stored key is never returned; only its fingerprint is shown.
settings.api_key_invalid: That does not look like a {provider} key.
settings.database_help: RevoAp boots without MySQL. A database is required for History, Statistic, the job queue and the audit trail.
settings.password_help: Stored in the runtime overlay, never in the static config.
settings.migrations_up_to_date: The schema is up to date.
settings.cache_help: Successful chat responses are cached by a hash of provider, model, messages and options. A hit skips the network call entirely.
settings.cache_purge_confirm: Delete every cached model response? The next runs will be slower and will cost real tokens.
settings.runtime_flags_help: Written to var/config/runtime.json and merged over config.php on the next request — no PHP-FPM reload needed.
settings.reset_all_confirm: This deletes the runtime overlay, every stored key and every flag. The static config.php is not touched. Type RESET to confirm.
settings.unsaved: You have unsaved changes in Settings.

admin.unlock_help: Enter the admin token from .admin.key at the project root.

unlock_attempts.one: {count} failed attempt — the form locks after {max}.
unlock_attempts.other: {count} failed attempts — the form locks after {max}.

admin.unlock_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
admin.not_protected: Settings are not protected by an admin key.
admin.not_protected_body: Every operator route is reachable without a token and nothing is asked for. Set Protect_Settings_by_Admin_Key to 1 in config.php or .config.php to require the key from .admin.key again.
admin.token_missing_body: Create .admin.key at the project root with `openssl rand -hex 32`, chmod it 600 and make it readable by the PHP-FPM user.
admin.token_unreadable: .admin.key exists but the PHP process cannot read it. Check ownership and permissions.

users.title: Users & access
users.subtitle: Who may run pipelines, who may administer, and what each API key is allowed to do.
users.role_help: Administrator: everything. Operator: run pipelines and edit models. Viewer: read-only. API client: /v1 only.
users.password_help: At least {min} characters. Stored as an Argon2id hash; the plaintext is never written anywhere.
users.password_weak: That password is too weak — it appears in a common-password list.
users.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
users.totp_setup: Scan the code, then enter the six digits your app shows.
users.totp_recovery_help: Store these somewhere offline. Each one works once; they are the only way back in if you lose your device.
users.api_key_reveal_once: Copy it now — this is the only time the full key is shown.
users.api_key_revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}? Every client using it stops working immediately.
users.user_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Their audit entries stay — the audit trail is append-only.
users.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with.
users.cannot_delete_last_admin: At least one administrator must remain.
users.rate_limit_help: Requests per minute for this key. 0 means the global default.
users.ip_allowlist_help: If set, the key only works from these addresses or CIDR ranges.

usage.ownership_flag: Enforce per-user ownership: anonymous visitors no longer see every session in History, Statistics and Share.
usage.title: End users & usage
usage.subtitle: Every pipeline identity, what its runs consumed, and the budget that limits it. Operator accounts (RBAC) are a separate surface.
usage.name: Name
usage.unattributed_hint: Runs whose caller presented no user identity. Real spend that belongs to nobody — wire API clients to a user_id to attribute it.
usage.no_users: No end users yet. Users appear once a run carries their identity.
usage.no_users_hint: Web-console runs are attributed to the local profile user; API runs to the user_id they pass.
usage.budget_none: No budget — this user's spend is unlimited.
usage.quota_warn: At or over the limit (runs still allowed)
usage.quota_not_checked: Budget enforcement is off (feature flag cost.budgets).
usage.coverage_hint: Share of model calls whose provider reported a price. Unpriced calls are real spend that no budget can see.
usage.export_hint: Download everything this installation holds about the user: profile, sessions with full text, and billing rows.
usage.resync_hint: Re-derive the ledger from council_model_responses for settled runs that have no billing rows.
usage.resync_converged: The ledger already matches the source rows.
usage.ledger_unmigrated: Migration 024 has not been applied — the usage ledger table is missing.
usage.cached_hint: Tokens read from provider prompt caches. Cache reads usually cost less; the ledger keeps the provider's own figure.
usage.failed_runs_hint: Failed runs still consumed tokens and are billed like any other.
usage.rbac_pending_hint: Console logins, roles and 2FA live in revoap_admin_users; that panel is still pending — see docs/ADMIN.md §3.
usage.my_subtitle: What your own runs consumed, and the budget that applies to them.
usage.my_identity_required: This installation enforces per-user ownership; usage requires an authenticated identity.
usage.my_no_data: No runs recorded for you yet.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.subtitle: Every administrative action, append-only. Nothing here can be edited or deleted through the UI.
audit.no_entries: No audit entries match the filter.
audit.retention_help: Entries older than this are archived, not deleted. The audit trail is append-only by design.
audit.integrity_help: Each entry stores a hash of the previous one, so a row removed at the database level breaks the chain.
audit.integrity_ok: The chain is intact across {count} entries.
audit.integrity_broken: The chain breaks at entry {index}. The audit trail has been modified outside the application.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Export everything needed to rebuild this installation elsewhere.
backup.name: File
backup.delete_confirm: Delete the backup {name}? This cannot be undone.
backup.restore_confirm: Restoring overwrites the current configuration and, if included, the database. Type the file name to confirm.
backup.restore_started: Restore started. The console reloads when it finishes.
backup.schedule_keep_help: Older backups are deleted automatically. Backups are stored under var/backups and are not served over HTTP.
backup.encryption_help: Provider keys inside a backup are sealed with a passphrase you choose. Without it the keys cannot be restored.
backup.corrupt: The backup is corrupt or has been modified.

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.subtitle: Recurring jobs: catalogue refresh, availability probes, statistics rollup, log rotation, backups.
scheduler.cron_help: Standard five-field cron in the server timezone ({tz}).
scheduler.cron_invalid: That is not a valid cron expression.
scheduler.no_history: This task has not run yet.
scheduler.overlap_skip: Skip if the previous run is still going
scheduler.timeout_help: A run that exceeds this is killed and recorded as failed.
scheduler.system_cron_help: Add this line to the crontab of the PHP user. It drives every task above through a single entry point.

budgets.title: Budgets & alerts
budgets.subtitle: Spend limits per period, and who is told when one is approaching.
budgets.name: Budget name
budgets.threshold_help: An alert fires once per period per threshold.
budgets.no_budgets: No budgets configured. Nothing is being limited.
budgets.forecast_help: Linear projection from the current period's spend rate.
budgets.forecast_over: At this rate the budget is exhausted {days} before the period ends.
budgets.unknown_costs: Some providers do not report a cost. Those runs are shown as “not reported” rather than as zero — an invented $0.00 is worse than a gap.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Where the console sends alerts: failed runs, exhausted budgets, a dead worker, a broken audit chain.
notifications.event_model_removed: A model disappeared from the catalogue
notifications.webhook_help: Each delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body; the signature is in X-RevoAp-Signature.
notifications.quiet_hours_help: Non-critical events are held and delivered as one digest instead of waking anyone up at 3 a.m.
notifications.digest_help: A single summary message at this time, in the server timezone.

queue.title: Job queue
queue.subtitle: The durable queue the CLI worker consumes. Jobs survive a restart; this page shows what is actually in it.
queue.throughput_help: Jobs completed in the last hour.
queue.backlog_help: Pending jobs. A backlog that grows while a worker is running means the worker is too slow, not that it is down.
queue.no_workers: No worker is reporting. Jobs stay queued and are not processed.
queue.no_workers_hint: Start it with `php bin/revoap-worker.php`, or install the systemd unit under deploy/systemd/.
queue.purge_confirm: Delete {count} completed job record(s)? The sessions and the audit trail are kept.
queue.dlq_help: Jobs that exhausted their attempts land here. Nothing leaves the dead-letter queue automatically.

logs.title: Logs
logs.truncate_confirm: Delete the contents of {name}? The file itself is kept.
logs.unreadable: The PHP process cannot read the file.
logs.redacted: Secrets are redacted before anything reaches the browser: bearer tokens, sk-… keys, DSN passwords and absolute server paths.
logs.no_permission: The Logs tab is disabled in config.php.

security.title: Security
security.firewall_help: Enforced at the very front of every request, before routing.
security.mode_whitelist: Allow-list — only these addresses may reach the console
security.rule_invalid: “{value}” is neither a valid IPv4/IPv6 address nor a CIDR range.
security.rule_loopback_stripped: Loopback ranges cannot be denied — you would lock yourself out.
security.current_ip_added: Your address is added automatically on every visit.
security.proxies_help: X-Forwarded-For is only honoured from these addresses. Trusting every proxy lets a client forge its own IP and walk around the firewall.
security.test_result_default: No rule matched; the default is {default}.
security.headers_help: Sent on every response. A failing check means something in front of the application (a proxy or a CDN) is stripping them.
security.csp_ok: Strict, self-only, nonce-based. No CDN origins.
security.hsts_off: Not sent — enable it with security.hsts.max_age once the site is on HTTPS.
security.secrets_help: Where keys live and how they are protected.
security.redaction_on: Active on every log line, API response and rendered page.
security.csrf_on: Double-submit token on every state-changing request.
security.rate_limiting_help: Per IP and per API key.
security.no_recommendations: Nothing to fix. Every check passed.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every past council session with its full audit trail.
history.rerun_same: Run the same query with the same models
history.rerun_current: Run the same query with the current selection
history.delete_confirm: Delete session {id}? The audit trail entries are kept.
history.retention_help: Sessions older than this are pruned by the scheduler task.
history.storage_warning: Prompts and model answers are stored in plaintext. The History tab is off by default for that reason.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Declarative workflows that define agent roles and consensus rules.
skills.delete_confirm: Delete the skill “{name}”? Runs that already used it keep their record.
skills.name: Name
skills.roles_help: Each role contributes a system prompt and a weight in the consensus.
skills.definition_invalid: The definition is not valid JSON: {message}
skills.generator_help: Describe what you want and a draft skill is written for you.
skills.generated: Draft ready — review it before saving.
skills.selector_help: How L0 picks a skill for an incoming query.

statistic.title: Statistic
statistic.subtitle: Aggregated usage of the council pipeline.
statistic.no_database: The Statistic tab needs a configured database.

api.title: API
api.subtitle: The REST surface under /v1 and the operator endpoints under /api.
api.openapi_help: Import into Postman, Insomnia or Swagger UI.
api.rate_limit_header: The remaining budget is in X-RateLimit-Remaining.
api.idempotency_help: Send Idempotency-Key on POST /v1/runs to make a retry safe.

worker.tooltip: Worker status — click for Settings → Worker
worker.restart_required: The worker is running stale code. Restart it to pick up this deployment.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: The runtime this console is executing on. Read-only.
system.opcache_off: OPcache is disabled. Expect a several-fold slowdown.
system.disk_low: Less than {free} free — log rotation and the response cache will start failing.
system.build_id_help: Confirms which commit the running process actually loaded. If this is stale after a deploy, OPcache is serving old bytecode.
system.env_warning: The console is running in development mode: debug output and stack traces are exposed.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.subtitle: Optional components that can be installed into this deployment.
extensions.md_scribe_help: Successor of MD.Viewer: viewer, editor and admin panel for the files under share/. Installed from the pinned, sha256-verified release archive.
extensions.md_viewer_help: Legacy install: an existing extensions/md-viewer/ keeps updating through its own updater. Fresh installs get MD.Scribe.

help.title: Help
help.keyboard_help: Everything in the console is reachable without a mouse.
help.concept_l0: L0 picks the consensus skill and the model pool for the query.
help.concept_l1: L1 sends the same prompt to every selected model in parallel.
help.concept_l2: L2 reduces each answer to a comparable structure.
help.concept_l3: L3 clusters the structures across models and scores agreement.
help.concept_l4: L4 synthesises one final answer from the agreed content.

shared.title: Shared run
shared.read_only: This is a read-only view. Nothing here can be changed.
shared.not_found: This shared link is not valid or has been revoked.
shared.revoked: This shared link was revoked by an administrator.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.403_body: The firewall or the admin gate rejected this request.
errors.500_body: The details are in the error log. The trace below is only shown because app.debug is on.
errors.503_body: The console is in maintenance mode. Try again shortly.
errors.provider_timeout: The provider did not answer within {seconds} s.
errors.provider_auth: The provider rejected the API key for {provider}.
errors.provider_404: The provider does not serve {model} any more. Pick an alternative or refresh the catalogue.
errors.provider_429: The provider is rate-limiting {provider}. The run will retry.
errors.worker_required: This run needs the background worker, and no worker is reporting.
errors.content_filtered: A provider filtered this content and returned no answer.
errors.too_many_models: At most {max} models can be queried in one run.
errors.report_issue: If this repeats, the debug trace under Help → Report a problem has what a maintainer needs.

maintenance.banner: Maintenance mode is on. Visitors see a 503 page; administrators are let through.
maintenance.allow_ips: Addresses that may still reach the console

feature_flags.title: Feature flags
feature_flags.subtitle: Turn parts of the console on and off without a deploy.

localization_admin.title: Localization
localization_admin.subtitle: Coverage of the five shipped catalogs, and the default locale for new visitors.
localization_admin.default_locale_help: Used when a visitor has no cookie and their browser asks for a language we do not ship.
localization_admin.lint_ok: Every catalog covers every key of en.json.
localization_admin.plural_help: A pluralised key needs one entry per CLDR category the language uses.

pending.one: {count} database migration has not been applied.
pending.other: {count} database migrations have not been applied.

migration_banner.body: Some features will misbehave until the schema catches up with the code.
